regions.text: 手な青年と知合ひになつて相営親密に交際をした。

quote.translation: Again, immediately after the World War I came to know S, a Russian in exile in Japan and a young man who played the piano well, and we were on fairly close terms.

regions.text: 彼は鎌倉の劇場でロシプ舞踊の件奏に出たこともあつた。

quote.translation: He once appeared as accompanist for Russian dancing at a theatre in Kamakura.

regions.text: 然るに彼が白系の一將軍の下に職闘に加はるためにハルビンへ旅立つた後は杏として消息が無かつた。

quote.translation: After he left for Harbin to join the fighting under a White general, however, there was no word of him at all, and I thought he might have been killed in battle.

regions.text: 脱死したかとも思ってるた。共後敷年して自分が獨週フライブルクに滑在してあた時のことである。神経痛の治療を受ける者について大學病院の電氣治療室へ行った。そこの助手がSであつたのには少なからず驚いた。彼は諸方を流浪した果逸にフライブルクへ來て醫學を修めて今は大學の助手になつてゐたのである。

quote.translation: Some years later, when I was staying in Freiburg in Germany, I went with someone who was being treated for neuralgia to the electrotherapy room of the university hospital, and I was not a little surprised to find that the assistant there was S. After wandering from place to place he had finally come to Freiburg, studied medicine, and was now an assistant at the university.

regions.text: 最初は大きい偶然といふ印象を受けたが、しかも矢張りかなりの可能性を有つてゐるのでよく考へれば偶然性が減じて来た。

quote.translation: My first impression was of a great chance, but this too had a fairly large possibility, and when I considered it carefully the contingency diminished.

regions.text: よく考へれば偶然性が減じて来た。日本で彼と話し

quote.translation: The language in which I had spoken with him in Japan was German.

regions.text: 日本で彼と話した言葉はドイツ語であつた。彼は革命の爲に學業を中止したのを苦だ遺域としてゐた。ま、た彼は日本にも獨特の文化はあるが歐羅巴の文化が感しいと云つてゐた。

quote.translation: He deeply regretted having had to break off his studies because of the revolution, and he had said that, although Japan had a distinctive culture of its own, he missed the culture of Europe.

regions.text: これらの事情からして彼がドイッへ行つて學業を卒へたことには相當の理由がある。その彼と自分とがドイッで同り合つたことには、発つて多分の可能性が含まれてゐる。

quote.translation: Given these circumstances there was good reason for him to have gone to Germany and completed his studies there, and our meeting again in Germany therefore contained a good deal of possibility.

regions.text: 偶然性は計らずもフライブルクのやうな南獨の小都市であつ

quote.translation: The contingency hung on the fact that it happened, without anyone's arranging it, in a small South German town such as Freiburg, and that he happened to be the assistant in the electrotherapy room.
